question: What conduct should a practitioner abandon after gaining equanimity through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equal mind
Village dharma is named as something to renounce
inference: Through practice, one who has become even-minded should abandon village dharma.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer to conventional social or household duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the dharma of village life.
